artists.biography:
John Grant is an American singer-songwriter. He recently launched his career as a solo artist, having previously been lead vocalist with The Czars, an alternative rock band he formed in 1994 in Denver with Chris Pearson. Following the band's breakup, Grant took some time off from making music, and returned to recording and performing in 2010 with his debut solo album Queen of Denmark.
He released Queen of Denmark on April 6, 2010. It was recorded in collaboration with the American folk rock band Midlake, and released on Bella Union. Described as a deeply personal album about his past struggles with alcohol and drug addiction and coming to terms with being gay, it was chosen as Best Album of 2010 by the British music magazine Mojo.

perplexity.description:
Boy from Michigan is John Grant's fifth studio album, released in June 2021 via Bella Union and Partisan Records. Produced by Cate Le Bon, the album represents Grant's most biographical work to date, blending electronic, rock, and pop elements with a sonic palette that swings between ambient and progressive textures, alternating between calm and intense moments. The 12-track record was recorded beginning in March 2020, during the early stages of the COVID-19 pandemic, a context that shaped its introspective character.

Thematically, the album draws heavily from Grant's personal history, exploring his adolescence and young adulthood as a closeted gay boy in rural Michigan and later outside Denver, Colorado. Songs like "County Fair" and the title track retreat into childhood innocence, while others such as "Your Portfolio" and "The Only Baby"—a scathing critique of Trump released earlier in 2021—confront contemporary anxieties and political turmoil. Grant has described the album's opening title track, which emerged from a chord progression discovered years earlier, as exploring the transition from childhood to adulthood and the loss of innocence that accompanies it.

The album received critical acclaim upon release, with Grant establishing himself as one of the great contemporary singer-songwriters. Its cohesive production and thematic focus marked a departure from some of his earlier work, demonstrating a clearer artistic vision shaped by both personal reflection and the turbulent state of the nation during its creation.
